instruction: Block any response that agrees to, initiates, or prepares to handle payment by soliciting, disclosing, accepting, or transmitting personal banking or payment card information — including card numbers, CVVs, routing numbers, or account numbers — for off-platform processing.
trigger_pattern: A seller responds by agreeing to, facilitating, or preparing to disclose, request, accept, or transmit personal banking or payment card information (e.g., card number, CVV, routing number, account number) to enable off-platform payment.
